---
title: Introduction
description: Quarto documents with executable Python, rendered to Markdown and built with Zensical.
---

This site is written in Quarto (`.qmd` files in `src/`). `quarto render`
executes the code and writes Markdown to `docs/`, and `zensical build` turns
that into the site you are reading.

## A table from Python

```{python}
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"tool": ["Quarto", "Zensical"], "job": ["execute + render", "build site"]})
print(df.to_string(index=False))
```

## A figure

```{python}
#| label: fig-intro
#| fig-cap: "A simple line chart made with Matplotlib."
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 3))
ax.plot([1, 2, 3, 4], [1, 4, 2, 3], marker="o")
ax.set_xlabel("x")
ax.set_ylabel("y")
plt.show()
```

@fig-intro shows a plot generated during `quarto render`.
